findings.text: follow-on: every test shares the process-global in-memory cache (the fixture at :65 clears _CORPUS_CACHES only at setup), so none exercises the on-disk corpus.json a warm promotion in a fresh process reads; a lossy serialize/deserialize would pass the whole suite and silently change production matches.

follow-on: _store_corpus_cache is called outside the try in clone_matches and raises on any write failure, which promotion_clone_matches swallows into an "unmeasured" clone report, so a read-only cache directory newly disables the clone scan where the pre-change code had no writable-cache dependency.

item_verdicts.diff: read against the parent revision 57dfae0345; one landed change (76c09104), two files changed, +294/-2, holding the digest cache and its four tests.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names a matches-equal case, a second-call-parses-only-the-changed-file case, an executed negative control and a re-profile; the manifest records head 11 passed against a 7-passed base with zero added failures, the negative control red at clone-scan/negative-control.log, and the profile pair.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is "A promotion's clone scan fingerprints only what the promoted diff touches, or reuses cached fingerprints"; reckon/clones.py:298 clone_matches parses a changed file from its head bytes and reads every other corpus file from a digest-keyed cache via _cached_functions (clones.py:207), so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states 11 passed at head against a 7-passed base, records the negative control, and names clone-profile/head-cold.json and head-warm.json.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared scope is reckon/clones.py, tests/test_the_clone_scan_reads_only_the_promoted_diff.py, the evidence fragment and the figures dir; the landed change at 76c09104 touches exactly the first two and nothing outside them.

justifications.durability: the negative control (clone-scan/negative-control.log, EXIT=1) reinstates the cache bypass and reddens test_a_second_call_parses_only_the_changed_file, which the head arm passes; docked because the on-disk corpus.json round trip a warm promotion in a new process relies on (_load_corpus_cache clones.py:242, _store_corpus_cache clones.py:253) has no test.
justifications.evidence: the gate tests/test_the_clone_scan_reads_only_the_promoted_diff.py:84 asserts the warm matches equal the cold ones and :97 counts parses to prove only the changed file is re-parsed, and the negative control reddens :97 (EXIT=1); docked because no test loads the cache through disk, so the on-disk corpus.json a warm promotion in a fresh process reads has no executed check.
justifications.fit: the cache follows the module idiom and its new names (_CachedFunction, _cache_key, _CORPUS_CACHES) carry no banned label; docked because clones.py:298 clone_matches and _index now carry list[Any]/_CachedFunction where their annotations still say _Function.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/clones.py:333 parses only the changed file and clones.py:207 serves every other corpus file from the digest cache, and the profile shows functions_in falling from 868 cold to 1 warm.
justifications.scope_discipline: the landed change at 76c09104 changes only reckon/clones.py and tests/test_the_clone_scan_reads_only_the_promoted_diff.py, both declared write paths, and carries nothing the goal does not imply.
